licence_policy_note: Owner decision 12 is open. Lead default: GPL/AGPL packs are installed but flagged (publishing such an image creates source-offer obligations); non-commercial, custom restrictive and unlicensed packs are left out of the new profiles until the owner decides. The `default` profile is exempt because it reproduces the production image.

default.description: Exactly the 31 packs of the image the bridge pins today (saved workflows keep working). Licence flags are reported, not applied. Any install failure fails the build, as before.

core.description: Smallest useful set: loaders, video I/O, graph utilities. Fastest cold start.

image.description: Image generation and editing (FLUX/FLUX 2, SD/SDXL, Qwen Image, Z-Image, Krea 2, inpainting, upscaling, faces).

video.description: Video generation and processing (Wan 2.x, Wan Animate, LTX, MiniMax H3, AnimateDiff, interpolation).

audio.description: Audio, speech, music separation and lip-sync.

prompting-utilities.description: Prompt building, captioning/tagging, logic and math utilities.

frontend-extensions.description: UI-only or local-tool extensions for the artist's own ComfyUI. Never installed in a cloud image.

research-experimental.description: Experimental or heavy packs; opt-in images only.

full.description: Every compatible, legally installable backend extension (licence policy applied); exclusions are reported with reasons.
